_doc: X-04 / 16 D20 — the DE strings. NOT MACHINE TRANSLATED (16 D20). Every value below is an untranslated placeholder carrying the ##TODO_DE## sentinel and the EN source, awaiting a human localiser; a build that ships to players must fail while any sentinel remains. Key convention: loc.<domain>.<id>.<field>, lowercase, dot-separated, snake_case segments (14 §6: loc.chapter.5.name). This file contains only keys that are genuinely referenced by data in this repository today; it is not a stub of strings the game does not yet have. {target} is a runtime parameter, not a translatable literal.
